title: The value of a rough first draft
body: Today I gave myself permission to make the ugly version first. The layout got clearer once I stopped trying to make every decision permanent.

title: Looking closely at type
body: I compared three typefaces at the same size and noticed how much their x-height changes the feeling of a page. “Readable” is not a single setting.

title: Designing for a real person
body: The most useful constraint today was imagining one person using the thing I was making. It pulled my choices out of the abstract and made them more generous.
